sources.snippet: For the paper we used the Lightning -module (PL) which simplifies the training process and allows easy additions of loggers and checkpoint creations. In order to use PL we created the model UNetDSAttention whose parent inherits from the pl.LightningModule. This model is the same as the pure PyTorch SmaAt-UNet implementation with the added PL functions.
